Build API Documentation + Key Management + Webhooks for Rankora at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`.

Read CLAUDE.md first, then read: `src/App.tsx`, `src/components/JobSidebar.tsx`, `src/pages/Settings.tsx`, `src/components/SidebarLayout.tsx`, `supabase/functions/guest-portal/index.ts` (edge function pattern).

## Migration — `supabase/migrations/20260409100000_api_keys_and_webhooks.sql`

```sql
CREATE TABLE public.api_keys (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  team_id uuid REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Default',
  key_prefix text NOT NULL,
  key_hash text NOT NULL,
  last_used_at timestamptz,
  revoked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_api_keys_hash ON public.api_keys(key_hash);
ALTER TABLE public.api_keys ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Users manage own keys" ON public.api_keys FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE TABLE public.webhook_configs (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  team_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  url text NOT NULL,
  events text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  secret text,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE public.webhook_configs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Team admins manage webhooks" ON public.webhook_configs FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));
CREATE POLICY "Team members view webhooks" ON public.webhook_configs FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (public.is_team_member(auth.uid(), team_id));
```

## Page — `src/pages/ApiDocs.tsx`
Route: `/api-docs`, protected, SidebarLayout, `max-w-5xl`.

Use Tabs: "API Keys" | "Documentation" | "Webhooks"

## `src/components/ApiKeyManager.tsx`
- Generate key: `rk_live_${crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g,'')}`, hash with SHA-256 via Web Crypto API
- Show full key ONCE in copyable code block with "won't be shown again" warning
- Store prefix (first 16 chars) + hash in DB
- List keys: name, prefix, created, last used, revoke button
- Max 5 keys

## API Reference (inline in ApiDocs.tsx)
Static documentation with styled Cards per endpoint:
- GET `?action=list_jobs` — list team's jobs
- GET `?action=get_job&job_id=...` — job + candidates
- GET `?action=get_results&job_id=...` — ranking results
- POST `?action=create_job` body: {title, job_description}

Code examples: curl, JavaScript fetch, Python requests. Use `<pre>` with monospace styling.

## Edge Function — `supabase/functions/public-api/index.ts`
- CORS: allow all origins
- Auth: validate `Authorization: Bearer rk_live_...` by hashing and looking up in api_keys
- Update last_used_at on each request
- Route by `action` query param
- Rate limit: in-memory, 100 req/min per key hash
- Returns JSON with proper error codes

## `src/components/WebhookManager.tsx`
Props: teamId
- List webhooks: URL, event badges, active toggle, delete
- Add form: URL input, event checkboxes (application_received, ranking_complete, stage_changed, interview_scheduled)
- Test button: POST sample payload to URL via fetch
- Active/inactive toggle

## Sidebar + Route
- JobSidebar.tsx: add "API" to settingsNav (Code icon from lucide)
- App.tsx: add `/api-docs` route with ProtectedRoute, eager import

- NEVER edit `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts`
- `(supabase as any)` for new tables
- `@/` imports, shadcn-ui only, Sonner toasts
- `max-w-5xl` consistent width
- Run `npm run build` — zero errors
